sources.title: Supergirl recap: Season 2, Episode 2 - ew.com
sources.verification: Kara and Clark face off against Kryptonite-powered Metallo. Clark blames Hank for the stolen kryptonite shipment. Four months ago, a shipment was stolen from the DEO. Cat takes a leave of absence. Alex discovers Agent McGill is the Cadmus mole. Mercy Graves ambushes Alex, declares war on aliens. Supergirl saves Alex. Superman and J'onn go to Fortress of Solitude, Kelex finds Prometheum. Clark takes and destroys the kryptonite, returns to Metropolis. Kara visits Cat. Mon-El wakes and chokes Kara.

sources.title: Recap of Supergirl Season 2 Episode 2 - CelebMix
sources.verification: Superman and Supergirl extinguish fire, stop bank robbers. Kara considers moving to Metropolis. Corben/Metallo on building ledge, shoots kryptonite. Superman carries Kara to DEO. Alex confronts McGill. Mercy Graves arrives, shoots McGill, tells Alex life would be better without aliens. Alex fights Cadmus agents, Supergirl arrives. New suits block kryptonite but devices destroyed. Alex and Hank help fight two Metallos. Kara visits Cat. James becomes head of CatCo. Snapper Carr as new boss. Hank gives Superman kryptonite, he destroys it. Mon-El wakes and chokes Kara.

sources.title: U73: canon style, butterfly carry-through, original transformative prose
sources.verification: Butterfly effects carry through naturally (chipped mug, theater mask magnet, bandage, DEO, bullpen, pattern, paper, ghost code, Marcus, parking lot, back gate). Canon beats woven naturally in show's emotional character-driven voice. Adrian's ordinary arc continues. Original transformative prose, not episode recap.
